newsitem.title: malaysia: KL palm oil ends mixed, spot Jan futures up again.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed, spot Jan futures up again.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Mar (3rd pos) 1,271 rgt/tonne Jan (south) 1,322.50
Open/Hi/Low 1,265/1,275/1,263 Prev close 1,317.50
Prev settlement 1,270 * sellers prices
PALM OIL FUTURES -Prices finished mixed with spot Jan

futures rising further on brisk buying. Elsewhere price movments were limited but players were uncertain about the near-term trend after the strong surge in recent days. Mar futures hovered steadily at around 1,270 ringgit level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Remained firm with nearby CPO and selected products seen firming strong on active demand.

Palm oil prices drifted uncertainly in late afternoon session, and closed mixed as there was still a squeeze in spot January futures which saw continued buying interest, they said The January futures contract was posted at a high of 1,303 ringgit a tonne at close as more shortcovering also emerged.
Elsewhere, trading were mixed mixed with price movements uncertain on profit-taking at higher levels.
Prices changes were narrow with most-active March futures hovering
steadily at around 1,270 ringgit level before closing at 1,271 ringgit ($512.30) a tonne.
Turnover on the futures market was 2,333 lots.
There was continued buying in the spot physical crude palm oil,
traders said.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,322.50 against bids at 1,317.50 after trading from 1,315 and 1,320.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,315 and bids at 1,310, with earlier
trades at between 1,310 and 1,312.50.
"The market has moved up a lot in recent days and there were some profit-taking seen at the highs," a trader said. "Dealing turned cautious as players were divided over the near-term trend," he said.
Some traders said the market could rise further despite high levels, because of the underlying bullish fundamentals. But others said the market needs a correction as prices had ran up too fast.
"With the cautiousness prevailing in the market, players are just taking a break and waiting for a clear path before making the next move," another trader added.
Turnover on the futures market was 2,333 lots.
There was continued buying in the spot physical crude palm oil, traders said.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,322.50 against bids at 1,317.50 after trading from 1,315 and 1,320.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,315 and bids at 1,310, with earlier trades at between 1,310 and 1,312.50.
